dct_title_s: Sea Ports of Heard Island and McDonald Islands
dct_description_sm: Sea ports, harbours and ferry terminals. Useful for maritime logistics, supply-chain analysis, and coastal access planning. Coverage reflects where volunteer mappers have been active. Urban areas are usually well represented, remote areas may be sparse. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. - Source: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org), a free, collaborative world map - Tags: [industrial=port](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Tag:industrial%3Dport), [harbour](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:harbour), [amenity=ferry_terminal](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Tag:amenity%3Dferry_terminal) - Part of the [exports grid on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot/) by [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/)
